$comment: The OTA web-bundle release descriptor (docs/desktop-ota-spec.md Stage 2).
Hand-maintained; the guards that keep it honest live in src-tauri/src/lib.rs.
version: an INDEPENDENT sequence, deliberately not the app's version
(RULED 2026-09-14). Reusing tauri.conf.json's version would make two
web-only updates between signed releases impossible — the second would
carry the same version as the first and the shell would report
'up to date'. Bump this for every bundle you publish.
minShellVersion: the OLDEST app version that may run this bundle. It is
NOT 'the app version that built the bundle' — that would refuse every
bundle on every install not already on the newest app release, which is
exactly the population OTA exists to serve. Raise it only when the IPC
surface loses or changes a command an OTA'd bundle would call.
commandsFingerprint: a pin, not a setting. It records the IPC surface
minShellVersion was last judged against; the guard recomputes it and
fails when they diverge, which is the prompt to decide whether the
change was breaking. Update it in the same commit as that decision.
